title: Evidence Code § 1235 — Inconsistent statement of a witness
text: Evidence of a statement made by a witness is not made inadmissible by the hearsay rule if the statement is inconsistent with his testimony at the hearing and is offered in compliance with Section 770.
holding: 证人先前不一致陈述可作实质证据采纳，但需符合 § 770 的弹劾条件。
notes: '(Enacted by Stats. 1965, Ch. 299.)' — original 1965 enactment, in force in 2013.
